apps.name: Luma
apps.subtitle: Recovery, running, HYROX and fuelling from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: Luma reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and turns it into recovery, sleep and strain each morning, GPS running with splits and spoken cues, HYROX race mode and readiness, a food and supplement log, and a coach. Your data stays on the phone; the coach runs on your own Anthropic key and reads only what you let it. A personal, non-commercial build on open-source foundations, credited in the app's About screen; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 18. Luma Doctor, and a new Glimm. Luma Doctor (Recovery, Weekly check): every Sunday it checks the week against your own usual range: resting heart rate, HRV, breathing, skin temperature, blood oxygen, sleep, bedtime, recovery and training load. It keeps a log of every check. With your key connected and health sharing on, the strongest model your key reaches writes the read, whatever the coach is set to. It is not a doctor: it says what moved and when something is worth showing to one. Glimm is new: a face that shows how it feels, a leaf, freckles, and clothes. 2,944 things to wear; it dresses for the day (training, a slow evening, bed) and changes every day. Like or pass on an outfit and it learns your taste. Open the wardrobe to dress it yourself. It moves: it breathes, blinks, looks about, waves, yawns, stretches and checks its trainers. Tap the leaf, the head, a cheek, the belly, a hand or the feet and it answers. Talk with it: with your key connected, it answers in its own voice, changes clothes when asked, and can offer to remember something. Nothing is remembered without your yes. Glimm is on the Lock Screen heart-rate card, and in its own widget, dressed the same.
